title: ci: widen the Test Core matrix from 8 to 10 shards
body:
Fixes #34710
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Test Core 测试矩阵从 8 片加宽到 10 片(`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 里所有写死的 `/8` 宽度改成 `/10`),分片脚本自动跟随，阈值一个没动。
- 为什么改:11-16 刷新的耗时数据下，8 片里有 5 片的整包合计约 2195s,超过 1868s 上限,#34314 合不进去;源码规则写明「加宽矩阵或切更细，不许把片塞更满」,算下来要 9.4 片，取 10。
- 风险与回滚：费用每次完整 Test Core 多约 3.6 runner-分钟(2 片 × 每片固定开销约 1.8 分钟：拉代码、装依赖、建闭包;依据 2026-11-17 两次 schedule 全量跑的 16 个分片作业实测，现在一次全量约 136-148 runner-分钟，涨约 2.5%,merge queue 按推测构建次数放大)。测试本身的总秒数不变，只是切成 10 份。单片墙钟按文件里的模型(整包和/2.9 + 切片):用 #34314 的数据，最慢片测试步骤约 1247s → 1095s,纯整包片约 757s → 605s。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 的 `test` 作业(matrix 回退列表、`--shard`、`--total`、产物名)和 `test-gate` 的 `--leg "test/10:…"` 与 `OS_TEST_PLAN`;其次 `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` 新增的「RE-DERIVED AT 10」注释段。
- 两分钟验证：本分支上把 #34314 的数据集放进去跑 `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`,应看到 `10 shards ... whole legs 1769/222/1754/... within 1868s`;在 main 上同样操作是红的(5 片超上限)。
- 需要你做的:os-zhuang 审批本 PR(动了 `.github/workflows/**`,Tier H,含上面这笔 CI 费用),之后席位落地，再让 #34314 rebase 合入。

## What changes

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the Test Core `test` job and its `test-gate`: every spelling of the width moves from 8 to 10, nothing else. Job name `Test Core (N/10)`, the matrix fallback `'[1, ..., 10]'`, `--shard N/10` (partitioner and the per-file timing capture), the turbo-cache and drift `--site` / `--label` strings, the artifact names `test-core-run-summary-N-of-10`, `test-core-timings-N-of-10` and `shard-attest-test-N-of-10`, the attestation `--total 10`, and in `test-gate` the `--leg "test/10:..."` and the `OS_TEST_PLAN` fallback. Comments that state the width follow; the rationale block gains a `TEN since #34710` paragraph and the cost paragraph the 8 -> 10 reading. Cache keys carry only the shard index, so they need no change.
- `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs`: no code change. `SHARD_COUNT` is `liveShardTotal('test')` and reads 10 from the matrix. The `SHARD_COUNT` docblock gains `RE-DERIVED AT 10 (#34710 ...)` with the arithmetic and the 8/9/10/11 table on the 2026-11-16 dataset; the closure-allowance docblock adds its figure at 10 (783 / 9 = 87.00s).
- `scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs`: header text only (`Test Core (N/10)`, `--shard k/10`, `test-k-of-10`).
- `scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs` (delta round 1, the seat's ruling): its `SHARD_COUNT` was a literal 8 its comment called the live width; it now reads ci.yml's `test` matrix through `liveShardTotal('test')` (scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs), the source the partitioner uses, and its comment says so. It stays only the matchers' default: the live lane judges each run at its own width. Self-test: the name-matcher pins are spelled at the live width (`W = SHARD_COUNT`, a non-live width `W + 1`), and each also pins an 8-wide name read at its own width, so a retained pre-resize run stays pinned; the eligibility and candidate fixtures stay an 8-wide run judged at its own width, on purpose; the firing control now reds by name when the live width equals its 6-wide fixture, where it used to `return`. The partitioner's note on this file follows.
- No bound moved: `WHOLE_LEG_CAP_SECONDS`, `LOAD_SENSITIVE_APART`, `MAX_SHARD_OVER_MEAN`, `SLICE_COUNT_HYSTERESIS`, `FILE_SHARDED_PACKAGES` (CLI at 3) and `PREVIOUS_FILE_SHARDED_PACKAGES` are unchanged, and the dataset `scripts/test-shard-timings.json` is untouched.

Required checks: branch protection requires the bare `Test Core` context, published by `test-gate` (`name: Test Core`), not the per-shard `Test Core (N/M)` jobs. `check:required-contexts` reads N from the matrix through `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs`, and no registry or gate names a `Test Core (N/8)` context.

## Tests

No partitioner pin reds at 10, so no pin was re-derived. The one test file changed is the self-test inside `scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs` (delta round 1, above).

- `node scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs --self-test`, (a) committed dataset at 10: `self-test OK (79 measured packages -> 81 shard items, 10 shards, max/mean 1.05x [bound 1.3x], floor 1009s, bins 1304.07/1235.93/.../1233.65s within the 1432.04s density cap, whole legs 44/1236/1236/1235/1234/1236/1236/1234/757/756s within 1868s, file-level slices: @objectstack/cli x3)`.
- Same, (b) with #34314's dataset (`git show 5009c644:scripts/test-shard-timings.json` into a scratch worktree, not committed), at 10: `self-test OK (82 measured packages -> 84 shard items, 10 shards, max/mean 1.01x [bound 1.3x], floor 1769s, ... within the 2245.53s density cap, whole legs 1769/222/1754/1754/1006/1005/1753/1756/1753/1754s within 1868s, file-level slices: @objectstack/cli x3)`.
- Control, (b) at 8 on `origin/main`: exit 1, `whole leg, committed dataset at 8 shards (sums 2195/663/2193/2194/1446/1445/2193/2195s)`, shards 1, 3, 4, 7, 8 past the cap and objectql with plugin-security on 8/8: the card's red, reproduced.
- Other width readers, all at 10: `node scripts/ci/plan-test-core-shards.mjs --self-test` (23 cases), `pnpm check:shard-attestation` (runs the ci-shard-matrix self-test; 360 assertions), `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `node scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs --self-test`, `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity`, `node scripts/check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs --self-test`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs --self-test` :: exit 0, `select-shard-timings-run: self-test OK`. Cases per battery, read by a temporary instrumented copy before (67be267b99) and after (b238da2b57): 37/9/13/17/18/13/5 = 112 both, so no case was dropped or added. Mutant `SHARD_COUNT = 8` at the head (temporary copy): exit 1, `job matcher: a job from a different shard count was accepted`, so the live-width pins read the live width.

## Acceptance notes

- Refresh lane across the width change: `select-shard-timings-run.mjs` judges each run at its own width (`runIsEligible` with no count reads `M` from the run's own `Test Core (N/M)` jobs), so the retained 8-wide schedule runs stay eligible and the 10-wide runs after this lands are eligible too. Measured on this PR's own rehearsal of the refresh lane (`Regenerate the shard-timings dataset`, job 133947759319, dry run): it selected the 8-wide schedule runs 44043569490, 44014522626 and 43985144717, downloaded shards 1-8 of each, and the partitioner's verdict on the refreshed dataset at 10 read `PARTITIONER_EXIT: 0`.
- Generator decode: `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs` does not decode the width from `test-core-run-summary-N-of-M`; it decodes slices by digest against `FILE_SHARDED_PACKAGES` / `PREVIOUS_FILE_SHARDED_PACKAGES`, which are unchanged, so the runs made at 8 decode exactly as before.
- Spec is now the floor: on the 2026-11-16 dataset `@objectstack/spec`'s whole 1769.27s is the heaviest bin at 10 (1.01x the mean, 99s under the cap) and its whole leg is 1769s at any width. A refresh that takes spec past 1868s needs a finer slice of spec, not an eleventh shard.
- Per-shard turbo cache keys carry only the shard index, so on the first runs after this shard k restores the cache shard k saved at 8 wide, which held other packages; that costs local cache hits once and never correctness, and the remote cache is unaffected.
- `timeout-minutes: 60` on the `test` job is unchanged; ten shards shorten every shard's tests step in the wall model.
- Seen in the same rehearsal, not from this diff: the refresh lane's regression diff (`measure-test-shard-timings.mjs --diff`) refused with exit 1 on main's tree, because `packages/cli/test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts` declares `test-budget: 58`, off the 10 s grid its header format requires; the lane then reports its regression readings as NOT MEASURED. Filed as #34711.

## Verification

At head b238da2b57 (the branch after merging origin/main f6f5b50a05):

- Local derived gate subset, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 67 families (the 65 of round 1 plus `select-shard-timings-run.mjs --self-test` and `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs --self-test`), all exit 0. `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first ran while a locked `pnpm build --concurrency=2` was still writing built output, and were re-run after it finished (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, 119/119 tasks), as were three other gates that read built output. The `--ran` reconciliation reads `67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- PR check-runs on this head, all 46 completed: `Test Core` success (the plan started `Test Core (1/10)`, `(2/10)` and `(3/10)`, all success), and `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` and `Regenerate the shard-timings dataset` all success; the rest skipped by their filters.
- Not run locally: `pnpm lint` and the full farm, which are CI's. Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
